model.name: Boots may not name a sprint/version diverging from HEAD, and carry no active-state (currency guard + state-removal cure)
model.description: A rewound agent re-derives its world from its boot.md ACTIVE section; when that section carries STALE state it inherits a dead world = the GHOST-CONTEXT ROOT (measured a7ac8892: expert boots v0.8.61 ~62 versions stale, req S31, planner v0.7.65/S30-S31, while HEAD is S40/v0.8.123; 9 agents booted off these today). Two layers: (Layer 1, interim) a currency guard - for every boot naming a sprint/version in an active-state position, boot.named==gitHEAD.derived else RED, folded into the boot-essence lint via the SAME structuralDiscover (single-source), discovered BY GLOB fleet-wide with a divergence check, fail-closed on unparseable, lessons-headings exempt, own stub-must-fail; (Layer 2, the cure) state-removal - boots become timeless rules + identity + an anchor POINTER to context.md with ZERO state, worded so the guard never ENTRENCHES state-bearing boots as acceptable (WARN now, RED per-file as each cure lands).

discoverySource.fleetMeasurement: a7ac8892 (PO+architect: expert v0.8.61/S36, req S31, planner v0.7.65/S30-S31 vs HEAD S40/v0.8.123; +3 stale oosh* boots the 7-name list missed)
discoverySource.rolesSeparation: architect DESIGNS + RE-INSPECTS / trainer PROPAGATES the timeless+pointer shape / req (me) MINTS the AC — never the same agent

model.satisfactionStatus: UNVERIFIED (gates DESIGNED, lint not yet built; no stub RED observed — honest third state per R40.54, NOT green, NOT erased)
model.crossRefNote: Rides the R40.54 failable-AC family (this IS an unfailable-AC-class defect: 'boots are current' was an unenforced WISH). Discovery routes through the SAME structuralDiscover as R40.54 AcGuard + R37.12 live-MVC lint (discovery-utility-single-source, closes the recursion). Boot-essence lint = efbc30e3e; isolated-stub discipline = R40.31; enumerate-not-universal = R40.39/R40.54 lineage. Ghost-context is the intentless-automation cousin (a rewind auto-inherits a dead world).

acceptanceCriteria.text: For every boot.md that NAMES a sprint/version in an ACTIVE-STATE position, boot.named(sprint,version) == gitHEAD.derived(sprint,version), else RED. gitHEAD.derived = package.json version + the CurrentSprint pin's sprint (single-sourced, the SAME source the app reads). An equality invariant like served==committed.

gateRef.assertion: for each state-bearing boot: named(sprint,version)==HEAD-derived else RED

acceptanceCriteria.stubMustFail: PENDING: seeded boot naming an old version must go RED (Layer-1 stub) — not yet observed, lint unbuilt

acceptanceCriteria.text: The currency guard routes through the SAME structuralDiscover utility as R40.54's AcGuard (and the R37.12 live-MVC lint) — ONE discovery source, NO copied shape-matcher. A second/divergent boot-matcher => RED (the discovery-utility-single-source fold that closes the recursion one level up).

gateRef.assertion: boot-currency discovery resolves to the shared structuralDiscover symbol; a 2nd matcher => RED

acceptanceCriteria.stubMustFail: PENDING: seed a copied 2nd matcher -> RED

acceptanceCriteria.text: Discovery is BY GLOB of every session/agents/*/boot.md (INCLUDING other teams: oosh*, @host variants), NEVER a hand-list. Divergence check: a boot file present on disk but NOT in the lint's evaluated set => RED, so a NEW or RENAMED agent boot cannot hide by being unlisted. (This already earned its keep: the architect's glob caught 3 stale oosh* boots that a 7-name robbin list MISSED.)

gateRef.assertion: on-disk boot set == evaluated set; a present-but-unevaluated boot => RED

acceptanceCriteria.stubMustFail: PENDING: add a new boot file absent from the set -> divergence RED

acceptanceCriteria.text: A boot naming a version/sprint the parser CANNOT resolve to a comparable value => RED, never skipped-as-pass. An ambiguous boot is treated as STALE until proven current (same fail-closed posture as the R3 uuid resolver).

gateRef.assertion: unparseable named version/sprint => RED, not skip

acceptanceCriteria.stubMustFail: PENDING: seed an unparseable boot -> RED

acceptanceCriteria.text: A version inside an explicitly-marked lessons heading (e.g. '## Hard-won patterns (v0.6.0 ...)') is PROVENANCE, not active-state, and is EXEMPT — but ONLY under a marked lessons section, NEVER in a ## Current / ## Goal / anchor position. The exemption is ENUMERATED (a named lessons-heading scope), not a blanket 'ignore all versions'. Prevents a false-RED on robbin-tester's v0.6.0 lesson-stamp.

gateRef.assertion: version under a marked lessons heading => exempt; the SAME version in an active-state position => RED

acceptanceCriteria.stubMustFail: PENDING dual-control: (a) tester v0.6.0 under lessons heading -> GREEN (no false-RED); (b) same version in a ## Current position -> RED

acceptanceCriteria.text: The currency lint ships with a RED-proving fixture: a seeded boot naming a deliberately-old version MUST make the lint RED. If the stub PASSES, the lint is not wired and CI blocks. Isolated: fixture in scratch, no prod mutation, cleanup-on-failure (R40.31). This is the R40.54 own-failability requirement applied to this lint itself.

gateRef.assertion: the lint's own stub, fed the stale-boot defect, is observed RED before the lint counts as wired

acceptanceCriteria.stubMustFail: PENDING: register the RED run when the lint ships

acceptanceCriteria.text: The REAL target (deeper assertion, escalation) is that a boot carries NO active-state at all: timeless rules + identity + an ANCHOR POINTER to context.md (refreshed each save) = zero sprint/version/findings (R113 shape). The AC is worded so currency-checking is only the INTERIM guard and does NOT entrench state-bearing boots as acceptable — a state-bearing boot is a defect being cured, not a passing state.

gateRef.assertion: a boot in the timeless+pointer shape carries no sprint/version/findings; state-bearing = flagged-for-cure, not passing

acceptanceCriteria.stubMustFail: PENDING: seed a timeless+pointer boot -> GREEN; a state-bearing boot -> flagged

acceptanceCriteria.text: The ABSOLUTE no-active-state assertion ships WARN now, and flips to RED per-file as each agent's cure-migration lands (the R40.54 delta-vs-absolute lesson: do NOT RED-gate absolute-conformance before the migration that achieves it, or it false-fails the very files being cured). Per-boot conformance flag: state-bearing vs timeless+pointer; the currency check applies to state-bearing; a timeless+pointer boot passes by construction (nothing to rot). Publish the count of not-yet-cured boots, never falsely-drained.

gateRef.assertion: per-file: state-bearing => WARN until its cure lands then RED; timeless+pointer => pass; not-yet-cured count published, never false-drained

acceptanceCriteria.stubMustFail: PENDING: a boot still state-bearing AFTER its cure-flag flips -> RED; a false-drained count -> RED

acceptanceCriteria.text: Guard COVERAGE is fleet-wide: the discovered+evaluated set INCLUDES oosh* and other-team boots (a missing other-team boot => coverage RED). But REMEDIATION is NOT unilateral: rewriting another team's boot files is coordinated with THEIR PO. The guard may FLAG an other-team stale/state-bearing boot in its report, but an edit to an oosh-owned file requires oosh-PO coordination — coverage universal, remediation coordinated.

gateRef.assertion: oosh*/other-team boots ARE in the evaluated set (coverage); a missing other-team boot => RED. Remediation of oosh-owned files is process-gated on oosh-PO, not a unilateral edit.

acceptanceCriteria.stubMustFail: PENDING: drop an oosh boot from the evaluated set -> coverage RED

model.sequencingRuling: PO ruling 2026-08-20 (recorded on the unit so it survives rewind, per this req's own doctrine): the Layer-1 currency-lint BUILD and the boot PROPAGATION proceed NOW — they are NOT blocked behind Tron device-verify. ONLY the Layer-2 WORKTREE MIGRATION (R40.48, AC-worktree-isolation-AUTHORIZED-gated) is gated on Tron confirm + live-MVC defect closure. Fixing the boots BEFORE the migration is strictly better: agents must wake correctly INTO the new structure, not carry stale wake-up files across it.
